Intertitre · Love the calf sleeves
Paragraphe · "I bought these because I’ve been work…
settings.text: "I bought these because I’ve been working on improving my running and usually get shin pain, but I wore these after working out for two days and already noticed a difference in how I felt while running. I know you can use them while running as well but I usually use them for recovery after a run or lifting. I’m definitely going to buy more and they are super easy to slip on and off."

settings.repere: Paragraphe · — Kawkab T. (5/5)
Intertitre · Love my Bombas calf Sleeves!!
Paragraphe · "I use these almost daily for work esp…
settings.text: "I use these almost daily for work especially if I know I’ll be standing for most of the day. I also use them when I know I’m going to be sitting most of the day. I especially love using them when I go for a jog! My legs are short so these fit better than the regular socks. I actually bought the calf socks knowing the length of my legs are shorter than average. The sleeves are a little log but I make them work by not stretching them too much when putting them on. The width is good and true yo size, but the length is a little long for me."

settings.text: "I work in retail and travel a ton. I found compression socks to be beneficial in both areas. These sleeves are invisible when I wear crop pants and clogs/sandals that do not require socks. My legs are less tired after hours on concrete floor!"
